title: Gemma 2 2B Release
summary: Google released the Gemma 2 2B model on July 31, 2024, making its model weights available through Kaggle, Hugging Face, and Vertex AI Model Garden and making the model available to try in Google AI Studio.
significance: A dated expansion milestone in the Gemma 2 family, following the initial June 27, 2024 release of the 9B and 27B models.
